scope: Isolated headless Edge, three actual map entries, native AudioNode destination recordings, visible settings and mute controls. Only read-only game snapshots; no game audio API or progress injection.
limitations: This measures signal, sampled clipping, silence, and restoration. It is not a subjective listening verdict.
The pure-music window includes the night score’s intentional whole-bar rests. Silence within a written phrase is not by itself a failure.
The tap records the graph feeding the browser destination, not physical loudspeaker or OS mixer output.

checks: Actual map destination emits finite unclipped signal with its default scene mix
Visible settings isolate music; a full phrase including written rests still produces actual sampled output
Actual sound button reaches digital silence at the native output
Unmute restores actual music without changing the isolated user faders or adding ambient loops
